Event.Name: Online Lottery
Event.Description1: Stay online and take part in the scheduled lottery.
Event.Description2: Winners are selected automatically by the event system.

Event.Name: Quiz Event
Event.Description1: Answer the event questions before the other players.
Event.Description2: Use the configured quiz command when the round begins.

Event.Name: Bonus Event
Event.Description1: A scheduled server bonus will become active.
Event.Description2: Check the event notices for the active bonus type.

Event.Name: Drop Event
Event.Description1: Special drops become available during this event.
Event.Description2: The configured maps and monsters determine the rewards.

Event.Name: Moss Merchant
Event.Description1: Moss the Merchant will open his special store.
Event.Description2: Visit the configured location while the event is active.

Event.Name: Pandora Event
Event.Description1: Pandora's event is approaching. Prepare for its challenge.
Event.Description2: Rewards follow the configuration in Pandora.xml.

Event.Name: Speed Event
Event.Description1: Find the event NPC and be the first to reach it.
Event.Description2: The timer reads the schedules configured in SpeedEvent.xml.

Event.Name: Scramble Words
Event.Description1: Unscramble each word and answer before everyone else.
Event.Description2: The timer follows the schedule in ScrambleWords.xml.
